none: PAS FindID 1016399: Roman coin: radiate, possibly of Victorinus
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Radiate, possibly of Victorinus (269-271),worn or thinned to one side, Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate head right. Obverse inscription: [---]INVS AVG. Reverse description: Soldier standing left with vertical spear, either holding pinnacled object in extended right arm – or a miniature Victory left. A in left field, XI in right field. Reverse inscription: [--] C [--]. Diameter: 17.9mm, Weight: 0.99gms, die axis: 12
